name: WebDrop
description: Nearby file sharing in the browser, with proximity checks and direct WebRTC transfers.

paragraphs: AirDrop for the open web — proximity-verified, peer-to-peer file transfer that runs in any modern browser.

WebDrop is a mobile-first, zero-build static PWA for AirDrop-style file transfer between nearby devices — no app install, no account, no cloud upload. Two phones discover each other, prove they are physically close (an ultrasonic + bump/tilt "ceremony", or a QR scan), then stream files directly peer-to-peer over WebRTC data channels. Files never touch a server.
